research_notes: The successor invocation should treat the scheduled wake as a continuation opportunity, not assume the predecessor necessarily closed exactly at target.
It should read close evidence to compute actual idle gap and wake jitter.
If predecessor close is missing, it should not launch a higher target until classification is resolved.
This prevents cascading false advancement after an abrupt tail failure.
The current pre-arm design makes that recovery possible without a separate replacement automation.
No additional scheduler mutation is needed now.
